description: Election Commission - A. D. Vimukthi Daraka Edirisinghe is appointed as a member of Poojapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Poojapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party, which falls under Election-related matters.
